title: Orphan Obliterator
description: A minecraft mod that allows one to harness the power of orphans.
body:
# Orphan Obliterator

This mod adds the ability to harness the **power of orphans**, as once shown to us by a legendary pig warrior.

It adds **armor**, **items**, and **three special swords** made of the very essence of these orphans.

Please refer to this guide in order to get started:
